responsibility: Implements the analyzer state machine and known-function models for POSIX file descriptors and socket APIs. It tracks descriptor validity, checkedness, access mode, closed state, and socket lifecycle phases across operations such as socket, bind, listen, accept, connect, pipe, isatty, and read; derives mode information from stashed frontend constants like O_* and SOCK_*; and emits the fd-specific warnings for leaks, double-close, use-after-close, access-mode mismatches, and phase/type errors.
